text:
incident-bot: [P1] Tenant="BorealisCorp" | vpc-dedicated-us-east-1 | spike: 5xx rate 18% (5m) -> paging oncall-sre (jessica) :rotating_light:

jessica: acked. I'm on it — joining metrics/traces now. Can someone post the tracer link and the model variant currently serving?

leo: tracer -> https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/8f3a2b (5m window). Serving model: borealis-gpt-3.2-large, quant=8bit, pinned: none.

ashley-ml: seeing tokenization errors + repeated OOM logs around worker-7 in the dedicated pool. Suggest immediate safe-variant fallback: borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 (smaller context + deterministic sampling).

jessica: oncall will do staged swap. Plan: 1) route 25% traffic -> safe-variant, monitor 2) if errors drop <2% start full swap. Executing now.

jessica: running CLI: redwood route swap --tenant borealiscorp --from borealis-gpt-3.2-large --to borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 --percent 25

incident-bot: Action recorded: route-change requested by jessica at 1719790065. Auto-escalation disabled for BorealisCorp (enterprise agreement).

maria-am: Pinged Borealis SRE on-call (borealis-oncall@borealis.com) and account lead. They approved emergency safe-variant for up to 30m. They want logs and ETA to full restoration.

dana-ps: Noted. Also enabling KV-cache bypass on safe-variant to avoid stale prefix issues. Command: redwood config set --tenant borealiscorp --model borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 --kv-cache false

sam-support: Notifying CS ticket #B-4521: "Seeing 5xx at scale; mitigation in progress. Will update in 10m."

jessica: 25% routed. Error-rate dropped from 18% -> 6% within 90s. Proceeding to 60%.

jessica: redwood route swap --tenant borealiscorp --from borealis-gpt-3.2-large --to borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 --percent 60

incident-bot: Warning: Dedicated pool load on node worker-9 high (92%); monitoring for new hotspots.

ashley-ml: good sign. But model mismatch observed in some request schemas (client uses new function-call field). We'll enable compatibility shim on safe-variant for 10m: patch applied (build 2026.03.17-ashley-shim).

leo: After 60% swap errors down to 1.1%. Going to complete 100% swap in 3m unless objections.

maria-am: Borealis on-call replied: "Proceed, keep us updated every 10m. We want full logs after."

jessica: executing final swap: redwood route swap --tenant borealiscorp --to borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 --percent 100 --force-confirm

incident-bot: Completed: full traffic now on borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 at 1719790242. Post-mitigation errors: 0.4% (baseline 0.3%).

ashley-ml: Follow-up actions: 1) collect request samples that triggered OOM 2) run model repro locally 3) propose quant/alloc tuning or a minor model patch. I'll take item 2 and 3.

dana-ps: Creating temporary tenant pin to prevent auto-rollouts: redwood tenant pin --tenant borealiscorp --model borealis-gpt-3.2-safe-v1 --ttl 72h

sam-support: Updated ticket #B-4521 with mitigation timeline and link to trace/log bundle: https://support.redwood/internal/borealis/B-4521

jessica: Monitoring for 20m. No further 5xx spikes in the first 12m. Leaving incident channel open for postmortem notes.

maria-am: I'll coordinate the customer postmortem and confirm if they want a dedicated follow-up call.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity lowered to P2 at 1719790360. Playbook: Tenant-pin + safe-variant routing applied. Owner for follow-up: ashley-ml.

jessica: Thanks everyone. Filing initial incident report now and assigning to ashley-ml for root cause and permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
